name: Single Score
notes: Area music fades out and stops before the next track starts, including rapid travel and repeated music toggles. Orc Island uses its dedicated theme throughout the island; the blacksmith keeps normal town music. Returning from a hidden tab or the character screen resumes one music track. Added reproducible normal-loot gear and XP comparisons checked against client and server formulas. Existing combat balance, items and character progression are unchanged.
